subject.title: feat: add Hermes Agent connector example

question: Should ClickClack bundle and continuously maintain this production-shaped Hermes connector, or should the reusable API and SDK primitives land separately while the connector remains an external package or follow-up?
rationale: The branch adds more than 4,000 lines, CI workload, a third-party runtime contract, operator configuration, and new public API behavior; code correctness alone cannot establish the intended repository boundary.

options.title: Split primitives and connector
options.body: Land the generic realtime and thread API work through current repository patterns, while moving the Hermes bridge to a separately maintained package or follow-up.

options.title: Bundle the connector
options.body: Accept ongoing maintenance of the Hermes Runs/SSE contract, connector CI, deployment guidance, replay semantics, and security configuration in this repository.

options.title: Pause the feature
options.body: Keep the feature unmerged until maintainers establish a general policy for production-shaped third-party connector examples.

recommendation.title: Split primitives and connector
recommendation.body: Land the generic realtime and thread API work through current repository patterns, while moving the Hermes bridge to a separately maintained package or follow-up.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is the explicitly assigned reviewer and best available owner for the repository-boundary choice.
